Energy mode: right-click any GT machine while holding the Link Terminal to attach a Link Anchor (Energy) cover — the machine then drinks from the wireless network like it was cabled in.

The cover keeps a capacity buffer of V x A x 800 ticks, injects up to V x A per tick, and refills from your wireless EU every 600 ticks with the configured downlink loss (15 percent by default). Removing the cover refunds its buffer.

Pointing at a machine draws a 3x3 grid highlight — yellow lines in Energy mode. Binding a Laser Source Hatch costs 1 Laser Vacuum Pipe.
